slides.headline: 5 things you probably missed this week
slides.subline: **Chips, climate, outages and more.** Swipe for the quick version.

slides.body: TSMC's board approved up to **$1 billion** in AI stakes: [[$500 million]] in Anthropic and **$500 million** in OpenAI. Both companies rely on TSMC chips.
On Nov. 12, a **Microsoft 365 outage** hit Outlook, Teams and Copilot in dozens of countries. Microsoft said it found [[no evidence]] of malicious activity.
China's CO2 emissions fell **3.1%** in Q3 2026, the [[biggest quarterly drop]] since the pandemic, says analysis by CREA for Carbon Brief. Mild weather helped.
UN climate talks in **Antalya, Turkey** were stuck on fossil fuels as of Nov. 18. Oil producers including [[Saudi Arabia]] were resisting stronger language.
The US officially lost its [[measles elimination status]] on Nov. 17 after 26 years. Mexico lost it too.
Which of these surprised you most? Tell us below.
